description: This file defines the RelatedProduct class, which extends Product and implements Serializable. It adds a relationShipType property with corresponding getter and setter methods.

classes.name: RelatedProduct
classes.description: A class representing a product related to another, with a specific relationship type, extending Product and serializable.

methods.name: setRelationShipType
methods.description: Sets the relationship type for the related product.

methods.name: getRelationShipType
methods.description: Retrieves the relationship type of the related product.
